newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill Lynch values Polish NFI units at PLN 233.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch values Polish NFI units at PLN 233.

text.p: Merrill Lynch recommended investors to buy Polish mass privatisation units valuing them in a report at 233 zlotys and advised them to hold back from exchanging them into shares of individual funds.

Merrill Lynch in London said in its June European Emerging Markets Report that it valued the units using the bourse's average price-to-book ratio and discounting it for the lower quality of the fund's assets and applying a discount used for pricing closed-ended funds.
In the report dated June 11 Merrill Lynch recommended investors to wait through the period of initially volatile trading of NFI shares before deciding to convert their units.

"In the potentially volatile weeks following listing (of the funds' shares) we believe the benefits of liquidity and broad exposure point to a 'wait until the dust settles' approach to conversion," it said.
